newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon adjust Latam portfolio.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon adjust Latam portfolio.

text.p: Salomon Brothers said analyst John Mullin adjusted the firm's Latin American equity portfolio.
-- lowered the recommended weighting of Brazil to 46.9 percent from 48.4 percent.
-- raised Mexico to 26.4 percent from 25.0 percent.
-- said move accomplished by shifting funds from Brazil's telecommunications sector, Telebras SA and Telesp, to Mexico's beverage sector, Grupo Embotellador de Mexico SA de CV.
-- said in a report Brazlian valuations are now near regional averages and its market momentum was "no longer compelling."
-- said Brazil's current account deficit and large external financing requirement constrain growth and pose the risk of interest-rate hikes later in the year.
-- called the Mexican market "cheap" and "the most attractive value play in the region.
-- said evidence of Mexico's economic recovery continues to mount.
-- said peso and interest-rate risks are "worth taking."
-- the portfolio was rounded out with Argentina at 8.5 percent, Chile 9.8 percent, Colombia 2.4 percent, Peru 2.4 percent, Venezuela 2.5 percent, and "other" 1.0 percent.
